plan.estimand: Main effect of 3-level factor in balanced 3-by-2 factorial ANOVA
plan.hypothesis: H0: the 3-level factor has no effect on the outcome (all 3 factor levels have equal population means); H1: at least two levels differ
assumptions: Balanced design: equal n per cell
Full interaction model (main effects + A×B interaction)
Common variance (homogeneity of variance across cells)
Test of main effect of Factor A (3 levels, numerator df = 2)
scientific_notes: Partial eta-squared = 0.06 is the effect size for the main effect of Factor A
In a balanced factorial design with partial eta-squared, the noncentrality parameter is derived from the effect size and sample size per cell

The denominator df depends on the total sample size: df_denominator = N_total - p, where p is the number of parameters in the full model (1 intercept + 2 main effects for A + 1 main effect for B + 2 interaction effects = 6 parameters)
